entries.german:
Die Brüder Leutold, Ulrich und Rueger, genannt Prueschinchen, schenken dem Cistercienserstifte Hohenfurt einen Mansus in Einsiedl.

Quoniam deprecacio justi assidua et deuocio multum valent felixque memoria summum bonum: nos igitur Levtoldus Vlricus et Ruegerus fratres dicti Prueschinchen venerabilis abbatis nec non tocius conuentus Altouadensis ecclesie Cysterciensis ordinis sancte deuocioni inuolui cupientes felicique memorie nos humiliter committentes notum esse volumus vniuersis, quibus exhibitum fuerit presens scriptum, quod eidem ecclesie predicte in Altouado mansum situm in Nevzadling cum omnibus suis redditibus et vsibus pretaxatis, soluentibus annuatim videlicet VI metretis siliginis vno modio auene VI solidis denariorum Wiennensium siue porco talento etiam pro steura nec non aliis minutis seruiciis, a nobis ibidem super altare gloriosissime Marie virginis iuste et racionabiliter delegatum concedimus et donamus perpetuo possidendum. Vt autem hec donacio permaneat inconuulsa et rata omnimodis teneatur presentes sibi literas cum appensione nostri sigilli dedimus et munimine roboratas. Testibus etiam subnotatis: Domino Wernhardo de Schaumberch seniore nec non fratre eius domino Hainrico filiisque eorum Hainrico seniore et Wernhardo juniore; domino Hainrico de Rosenberch, domino Johanne venerabile plebano in Netoliez, domino Vrso capellano necnon Rudolfo notario Prueschinchorum, et aliis quam pluribus fidedignis. Datum anno domini M o C oC olxxxii. in Protiwins in die sancti Egidii confessoris.

Siegel: Gut erhaltenes, thalergrosses, an Pergamentstreifen hängendes Siegel in weissem Wachs. - Vorderseite: Rundes Siegel. Ein Helm mit flügelartigem Schmuck. - + S. VIrici Prvschinchi. - Rückseite: Dreieckiges Siegel ein durch einen Querbalken getheilter Schild. - S. Levtoldi. Prveschin.
entries.english: We, Leutold, Ulrich, and Rueger, brothers called Prueschinchen, wishing to embrace the holy devotion of the venerable abbot and the whole convent of the Cistercian church at Hohenfurt, humbly commend ourselves to their good memory. We make known that we grant to that church, to possess perpetually, a mansus at Neuzadling with all its revenues and uses, which pay annually six measures of rye, one modius of oats, six Viennese solidi or a pig, a talent for tax, and other minor services. We have justly and reasonably assigned it there upon the altar of the most glorious Virgin Mary. To keep the gift firm and unshaken, we issued this charter confirmed by the appending of our seal. Witnesses: Lord Wernhard von Schaumberg the Elder and his brother Lord Heinrich, their sons Heinrich the Elder and Wernhard the Younger, Lord Heinrich von Rosenberg, Lord Johannes, venerable parish priest at Netolitz, Lord Ursus the chaplain, Rudolf, notary of the Prueschinken, and many other trustworthy men. Given at Protivins on the feast of Saint Giles, 1 September 1282. The well-preserved, thaler-sized seal of white wax hangs from a parchment strip: on the front is a round seal with a helmet and wing-shaped ornament, inscribed “Seal of Ulrich Pruesching”; the reverse shows a triangular shield divided by a crossbar, inscribed “Seal of Leutold Prueschin.”
